newsitem.title: USA: FAC Realty chairman Fleming resigns.
newsitem.headline: FAC Realty chairman Fleming resigns.

text.p: FAC Realty Trust Inc said its board chairman, J. Dixon Fleming, has resigned to pursue "international opportunities" and said it plans to search for a successor.
Fleming was also the company's chief executive officer before being replaced in November by C. Cammack Morton.

"In the past 15 months, we have replaced a majority of senior management within the company as well as many other key positions and now have a very experienced shopping centre team in place," the company said in a release late on Thursday, when it also announced that it would not pay a fourth quarter dividend.
